title: Green object over Savannah River Site engineers

tellings.quote: Anderson and his colleagues were quickly overtaken by a green glowing object angular and size darting back and forth erratically at high speeds and altitudes with phenomenal maneuverability

plain: In 1952, at the Savannah River Site, a US nuclear plant in South Carolina, an engineer named John Anderson and his colleagues were overtaken by a glowing green object, angular in shape, which darted back and forth at high speed and altitude with what was described as "phenomenal maneuverability." Michels reads this out himself, without naming the source, on an episode about UFOs watching nuclear sites, where it serves as an early case of such objects appearing over nuclear facilities.
